anomalies.expected: The specification says the TF-Luna LiDAR is not wired into the design: its pins are free and it is not connected to any net.

evidence.quote: Sheet 1/1, water-level section: “PR4 LiDAR”; H12 pins are labeled VCC, SDA, SCL, GND, with SDA/SCL wired to NET0007/NET0006 and VCC to +5V.

parsed.summary: The schematic connects a LiDAR device through H12 to +5V and the main I2C bus, while the specification explicitly describes the LiDAR as unwired with all pins free.
